title: Gift App Look And Name Deck
project: giving my gift to the world (public gift swipe app, Machan's second post on X)
example_data: All app screens are rendered HTML mockups with made-up SAMPLE data (recipient "Robin", .example stores).

optionA.label: Gift Swipe
optionA.desc: Says exactly what it does. Short, easy to say on X.
optionA.more: Clear for strangers seeing the post. The swipe is right in the name.

optionB.label: The Right Gift
optionB.desc: Promises the outcome, not the method. Warmer.
optionB.more: Feels like a gift itself. The swiping is the quiet surprise inside.

optionA.label: Machan's Gift Deck
optionA.desc: Puts Machan front and center, matches his X account.
optionA.more: Strong link to @Machan10001 and the first post. Less clear for people who do not know him yet.

optionB.label: For Someone You Love
optionB.desc: Emotional and open. Reads like a card, not an app.
optionB.more: Ties into "giving my gift to the world". Longer, harder to search.

pairs.ask: Which line goes under the name?

optionA.label: "Swipe to the gift they'll love."
optionA.desc: Action plus payoff. Tells you how it works.
optionA.more: Short enough for the X post and the cover.

optionB.label: "Find the gift. Skip the guessing."
optionB.desc: Speaks to the pain of gift shopping.
optionB.more: Punchy and relatable. Does not mention swiping, so the engine stays a quiet hint.

pairs.ask: What does the first screen show?

optionA.label: Big name, small Machan
optionA.desc: Name, one line, one button. Calm and confident.
optionA.more: Fast to load and to read. Machan sits above the name like a seal.

optionB.label: Gift card stack
optionB.desc: A fanned stack of sample gift cards shows what you will be swiping.
optionB.more: Shows the product in one look. A bit busier.

pairs.ask: On a laptop or wide monitor, the cover is…

optionA.label: Centered, one column
optionA.desc: Same as the phone, centered with lots of cream space.
optionA.more: One design everywhere; checked at 360, 390, 768, 1440 and 3440 wide.

optionB.label: Split: pitch left, demo right
optionB.desc: Pitch and button on the left, a live phone demo on the right.
optionB.more: Uses the width and shows the swipe in action. Collapses to one column on phones.

optionA.label: Guide who talks
optionA.desc: Small speech bubbles at key moments: start, round ends, reveal.
optionA.more: Gives the app a voice and a face, like the X account. Three or four lines in the whole hunt.

optionB.label: Quiet mascot
optionB.desc: No talking. He only shows on loaders, the reveal and the footer.
optionB.more: The app stays about the gift. Machan is a signature, not a host.

optionA.label: Only at the reveal
optionA.desc: One wink, at the moment the gift is found. Rare, so it lands.
optionA.more: Mirrors the first post on X, which ends on his wink.

optionB.label: At every round end
optionB.desc: A quick wink each time a round finishes, and at the reveal.
optionB.more: A little reward rhythm. Three winks per hunt.

pairs.ask: How loud is the hint that swiping is the engine?

optionA.label: Barely there
optionA.desc: Footer reads "Built by Machan · one swipe at a time". Only the curious notice.
optionA.more: Lets the people who know, know. The app never explains it.

optionB.label: A soft line at the end
optionB.desc: The final screen adds: "Found the way everything here is built: one swipe at a time."
optionB.more: Still gentle, but a reader will catch it. Appears once, after the reveal.

pairs.ask: How does the footer link look?

optionA.label: Small text link
optionA.desc: "Built by Machan" in small caps, links to his story.

optionB.label: Mark and text pill
optionB.desc: Tiny Machan plus "Built by Machan" in a soft pill. Tap to read his story.
optionB.more: More visible and more tappable (44px). Same link to his story.

optionA.label: Cream with terracotta
optionA.desc: Warm cream base, terracotta buttons, lagoon and jungle as small accents.
optionA.more: Matches the decks and Machan himself. Feels like paper and gifts.

optionB.label: White with lagoon
optionB.desc: Clean white base, lagoon buttons, terracotta only on Machan.
optionB.more: Crisper and more "app". Still light, never dark.
